snippet.title: Markiplier Played My Game And it went SUPER VIRAL
snippet.description:
i made 2 indie games and both of them went viral, being played by hundreds of creators with tens of thousands of downloads. In this video i explain how i did it!
Early access Discord: https://discord.gg/Fdhx4RxC2G
